Whether you appreciate classic holiday decor or want to add a touch of opulence to your Christmas tree, our Gold Teardrop Bauble Christmas Tree Hanging Decoration is a perfect choice.

8956086258441.sourceDescription:
This set of 12 khaki velvet Christmas bows gives you enough pieces to dress a staircase, tree or mantel evenly, so the arrangement looks full and considered rather than sparse. Each bow measures approximately 23.5 x 15.5 inches (60 x 40 cm), with a ribbon width of 0.98 inch (2.5 cm), a size that reads clearly from across a room. The muted khaki tone sits easily with natural and rustic schemes, pairing well with hessian, dried foliage and warm white lights.

The bows are made from dense, soft velvet with a sturdy pile. If one arrives flattened or creased from packing, reshape it by hand or press it lightly with an iron and it returns to a full, fluffy form. The fabric holds its shape, so the loops stay open and the tails hang straight once tied.

Tie them to stair spindles, a wreath, the front door, a window, a fence, a fireplace or a wall, or use a single bow to finish a wrapped gift box. They suit Christmas parties, festive gatherings and other themed events, and make a simple, thoughtful gift for friends, neighbours or colleagues.

Pack of 12 velvet bows. Colour: khaki. Material: velvet. Size: approximately 23.5 x 15.5 inches (60 x 40 cm), ribbon width 0.98 inch (2.5 cm). Measurements are taken by hand, so allow a small tolerance, and colours may vary slightly between screens. Keep away from children because of the winding risk.
Guarantee - 1 month

5056797098541.sourceDescription:
Bring a modern light show to your garden with this 2.4m RGB skeleton tree from MySmartBuy. 415 colour-changing micro seed LEDs form a striking tree outline, ready to glow in any colour you choose. Change colours, effects and brightness from your phone with the Hello Fairy app or with the handheld remote. Weather-resistant and quick to install, it is ideal for gardens, patios, entrances and commercial displays, and works indoors too. Ground pegs are included to hold it securely on lawns, in borders and beside pathways. Light up trees are a clever way to add festive height and impact without the mess of a real tree. 5096825926941.sourceDescription:
Artificial Christmas Tree
Adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Key details include reusable design and knitted texture.

Reusable Design
The reusable format is intended to be used again after suitable care. Keep it clean and store it between uses so it remains ready for the next occasion.

Knitted Texture
The knitted texture gives the surface a recognisable fabric character. It adds visible detail as well as a soft textile element to the overall design.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.
